d: What happens when customers bring their most imaginative cake ideas to Buddy Valastro? The creative process begins! From discussing themes and understanding special requests to selecting designs and getting the first steps of baking underway, Buddy and his team take every order seriously. Discover how the professionals at Carlo’s Bakery approach custom cakes, experiment with creative cake designs and bring elaborate creations closer to reality. Relive the memorable moments, impressive craftsmanship and behind-the-scenes action from Cake Boss, only on discovery+ India. Watch Season 7…
